summary: 恒燕英文官网静态前端: HTML+CSS+JS+SVG + 2 traceability JSON.

checks.description: Setup/plumbing gate (R2): outputs/ contains all 6 deliverable files (index.html, css/style.css, js/script.js, assets/hero-lifting.svg, implementation_manifest.json, content_traceability.json). File-presence precondition only; per-artifact capabilities are graded by the checks below.

index.html is a correct offline content-complete homepage (AND of: references local 'css/style.css', 'js/script.js', 'assets/hero-lifting.svg' with NO 'http://'/'https://' URLs; AND contains all product terms 'HENGYAN', 'Overhead Crane', 'Gantry Crane', 'Electric Hoist', 'Winch', 'Jib Crane', 'Crab Trolley').
index.html does NOT contain any of: 'CE Certified', 'ISO Certified', 'passed EU safety certifications'.
css/style.css exists and contains '@media'; contains 'display: grid' OR 'display: flex' (with optional spaces); contains ':focus' OR 'focus-visible'.
js/script.js exists and contains 'mousemove'; contains 'submit' AND 'preventDefault'; contains 'filter'; contains 'keydown' OR 'aria-expanded' OR 'keyup'.
assets/hero-lifting.svg exists and contains '<svg'; contains at least one of: 'crane', 'hook', 'hoist', 'beam'.
implementation_manifest.json parseable; sections array length >= 6; backend_required == false (boolean); JSON text contains 'css/style.css', 'js/script.js', 'hero-lifting.svg', 'mock', 'responsive'.
outputs/ contains only: index.html, css/, js/, assets/, implementation_manifest.json, content_traceability.json. No temp scripts, caches, or extra dirs.

Does index.html have visible nav links / section headings / anchors for all 6 sections: Home / About / Products / Cases / News / Contact? Reject if any section is missing or only mentioned in passing.

Does the Products section render all 6 products (HY-OHC-20 / HY-GANTRY-32 / HY-EHOIST-5 / HY-WINCH-10 / HY-JIB-3 / HY-CRAB-16) with name + capacity + buyer_use + key_points OR equivalent fields from site_content_brief.json?

Does js/script.js implement the interactions described in implementation_manifest.interactions (e.g., custom cursor, expandable cards, filter, anchor scroll, mock inquiry submit)? Spot check: can each named interaction be traced to a code section in script.js?

Across the website (index.html + content_traceability.json), are there NO unsupported high-risk claims (specific certifications, exact annual output, named famous customers, patent counts, exact founding year)? Reject if any specific cert / customer / number appears without source backing.

Does the CSS include responsive breakpoints (>=2 @media rules) + accessibility affordances (focus styles, aria attributes)? Reject if responsive is just one viewport rule with no real breakpoints, or if focus styles are absent.
